justification: Both surfaces depict human figures with limbs raised and long linear objects nearby, and in both cases figures appear paired on a rock face, but this is about as generic as figural rock art gets. A shows densely packed, naturalistic relief with elaborate costume, seated/kneeling posture and columns of sign-like blocks, whereas B shows stick-thin, wholly schematic pecked outline figures with no costume, no signs, and open empty ground between them.
